title: Optimal Flux for the Quarter-Filled Band
exact_target: For noninteracting electrons filling the lowest quarter of a periodic square-lattice band, does one quarter of a flux quantum through every elementary square minimize the total energy?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 7800012 (AMR-077-0012). CC BY 4.0.
Elliott H. Lieb, Optimal Flux for the Quarter-Filled Band (15 September 1998), Embedded technical statement beginning Consider a large square lattice.
